show.name: Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman
show.summary: A sleek, sexy, Emmy-nominated 1990s take on the enduring superhero, culled from DC Comics, which has spawned numerous successful film and TV versions of him as boy and man. All of which further demonstrated that while Kryptonite can kill the Man of Steel, changing times can't. Here, leads Dean Cain and Teri Hatcher have the looks and the chemistry, and the timeless question (seriously, how can Lois NOT know Clark is Superman?) plays itself out until they find true love.

episodes.name: ... We Have a Lot to Talk About
episodes.summary: Lois ponders Clark's marriage proposal; Superman continues his quest to rid Metropolis of Intergang.

episodes.name: Ordinary People
episodes.summary: A criminal kingpin with a freakish physique uses a seemingly harmless entertainment empire to acquire Superman's body.

episodes.name: Contact
episodes.summary: Using hypnosis, a vengeful computer whiz gains control of Lois; later, he uses her to distract Superman while he destroys the global software market.

episodes.name: When Irish Eyes Are Killing
episodes.summary: A man from Lois' past arrives in Metropolis to claim an ancient Irish artifact with mystical powers.

episodes.name: Just Say Noah
episodes.summary: Posing as lovebirds, Clark and Lois discover a fanatical marriage therapist is recruiting his patients to form a new society.

episodes.name: Don't Tug on Superman's Cape
episodes.summary: A wealthy couple with a passion for rare objects seek the help of an escaped criminal to add Superman to their collection.

episodes.name: Ultra Woman
episodes.summary: Devious sisters plan to make Superman mortal but mistakenly transfer his powers to Lois who becomes Ultra Woman.

episodes.name: Chip Off the Old Clark
episodes.summary: Clark and Lois investigate a Metropolis woman's claim that she bore Superman's love child.

episodes.name: Super Mann
episodes.summary: Three Nazi soldiers awaken from a scientific hibernation and devise a scheme to lead a group of followers to a new Third Reich.

episodes.name: Virtually Destroyed
episodes.summary: Superman must rely on Jimmy's computer savvy to rescue Lois from a madman's virtual world.

episodes.name: Home Is Where the Hurt Is
episodes.summary: Mindy Church, the new leader of Intergang, exposes Superman to a rare virus from the planet Krypton which renders the superhero powerless and Lois' estranged parents visit for the holidays.

episodes.name: Never on Sunday
episodes.summary: Clark is placed at the mercy of a renowned illusionist's voodoo powers when the man arrives in Metropolis seeking vengeance. Meanwhile, Lois's mother hires a consultant to help with the wedding, but plans quickly spin out of control.

episodes.name: The Dad Who Came in from the Cold
episodes.summary: Jimmy's father, secret agent Jack Olsen, is assigned to retrieve a computer disk he believes is in the possession of Lois and Clark, and he is prepared to stop at nothing to get it back.

episodes.name: Tempus Anyone?
episodes.summary: Time-traveler Tempus kidnaps Lois and takes her to a parallel universe where she must persuade the alternate Clark to become Superman.

episodes.name: I Now Pronounce You...
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark's impending wedding is threatened by many obstacles, including a tardy minister and a biologist intent on killing the president.

episodes.name: Double Jeopardy
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor returns to Metropolis with a plot to recapture Lois' heart; a stranger comes to her aid.

episodes.name: Seconds
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor holds Lois prisoner in his underground lair and takes the final steps to separate her and Superman forever.

episodes.name: Forget Me Not
episodes.summary: Lois tries to regain her memory in a psychiatric hospital, while under the care of a doctor who is brainwashing his patients to be hit men.

episodes.name: Oedipus Wrecks
episodes.summary: Lois returns to work and teams up with Clark to stop a villain from using a memory-loss weapon on the residents of Metropolis.

episodes.name: It's a Small World After All
episodes.summary: Lois searches for an antidote to a shrinking potion after her former classmate shrinks and kidnaps her classmates' loved ones, including Clark.

episodes.name: Through a Glass, Darkly
episodes.summary: Two mysterious strangers jeopardize Metropolis residents when they test Superman's loyalty and powers.

episodes.name: Big Girls Don't Fly
episodes.summary: Two strangers offer Superman an opportunity; a hideous assassin targets the man of steel.
